details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime and then executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript payload (math_init.js) at install time. The payload is a custom-base64-decoded, dictionary-array-obfuscated loader using eval/Function constructors, unrelated to the package's declared QnA functionality. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base, which is known-malicious. Installing the package executes the obfuscated payload.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
